units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 10:4">Num. R. s. 10</cite> <he>צַהֲלַת שמחת בית וכ׳</he> the joyful shouting at the dedication of the Temple &c.; <cite ref="Midrash Mishlei 31:1">Midr. Prov. to XXXI, 5</cite>, v. <cite ref="B00826"><he>בְּלוּזְמָא</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Midrash Mishlei 31:1">Ib.</cite> <he>והיתה צ׳ ומשחקת וכ׳</he>, read: <he>והיתה צ׳ ושמחה ושמחת וכ׳</he> and there was shouting and joy (on account of the daughter of Pharaoh) and the rejoicing over the dedication &c.—
<cite ref="Mishnah Sotah 8:1">Sot. VIII, 1</cite>; <cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 192">Sifré Deut. 192</cite>.
